# BIP340 vector attribution and license notice

Unmodified fixture: `bip340-test-vectors.csv`, from bitcoin/bips commit
`93f161194fbaed12c44f5e2a0c1d4f2b1b317cb0`.

The upstream BIP340 metadata names Pieter Wuille, Jonas Nick and Tim Ruffing as
authors, declares `License: BSD-2-Clause`, and declares code licensing as
`BSD-2-Clause OR MIT OR CC0-1.0`. Its copyright section states that the document
is licensed under the 2-clause BSD license. No specific copyright year is stated
there; this notice preserves that attribution without inventing one.

Primary metadata:
https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/93f161194fbaed12c44f5e2a0c1d4f2b1b317cb0/bip-0340.mediawiki
